items.title: CreatorMotion · Slide Focus Presenter
items.summary: A presentation fills the shot while a tightly cropped speaker stays beside the slide. Short page changes retain the deck geometry before a deliberate pullback reveals the surrounding workspace.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Source Quote Evidence
items.summary: The source heading remains visible while an enlarged excerpt becomes the reading plane. Sequential marker sweeps connect specific passages to the spoken claim and leave the complete evidence available.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Specification Status Reveal
items.summary: A small fact panel builds over supplied footage. A highlighted measurement appears first, followed by concise status labels that clarify what the number means.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Stage Loss Lanes
items.summary: Two paths develop stage by stage on the same percentage scale. Precise side pointers then identify the selected losses while every stage remains available for comparison.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Status Focus Sidebar
items.summary: A close presenter crop shares the frame with three widely spaced statements. A compact highlight moves between statements and each status resolves as a separate editorial beat.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Step Cards to Chapter
items.summary: Advance emphasis across linked step cards, then hand the frame to a chapter title. Use the final focus as the transition cue.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Surrounding Term Pressure
items.summary: Short terms appear around a central subject until the frame feels crowded. The subject then changes to a supplied photograph of an overwhelmed person while the terms remain in place.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Synchronized Action Checklist
items.summary: Track a screen demonstration with a checklist that completes at matching moments. Keep the checklist and media aligned in one composition.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Target Overrun
items.summary: A measured fill reaches a visible goal line and continues into a separately treated excess segment. The counter follows the same two phases and the final result holds beside the track.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Tiered Pyramid Notes
items.summary: Build a tiered pyramid and pair each layer with its matching explanation. Keep the vertical hierarchy readable as annotations arrive.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Tile Scene Dissolve
items.summary: A grid of small masks replaces one full-frame scene with a concise mark or statement. The cells reverse to return to the presentation.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Tilted Document Stack Cycle
items.summary: Full-height documents replace one another at the front of an angled paper stack. Earlier sheets remain visible at the edges, creating a tactile sequence rather than a carousel of rounded panels.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Timeline Node Reveal
items.summary: Reveal milestones in order along a shared horizontal track. Leave a clear settled interval after the final label.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Title Behind Subject
items.summary: A large title expands behind the presenter while the face remains clear. The layered result gives a short phrase more scale without covering the speaker.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Title Scene Takeover
items.summary: An oversized condensed headline punches in behind a presenter. A clean edit removes the presenter while the same lettering holds its scale and position.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Topic Cloud Behind Presenter
items.summary: A large topic title appears behind the presenter as related terms gather around it. Varied text sizes communicate a growing field of ideas while the face stays clear.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Trend Card Tour
items.summary: A close camera holds on one measured trend before travelling to the second. Both cards return to the frame for the concluding comparison, preserving all labels and values.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Voice Transcript Handoff
items.summary: A compact recording control sits over a dimmed workspace while the live transcript accumulates below. The accepted sentence moves into the destination field and the workspace regains priority.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Wall Checklist Reveal
items.summary: A camera reframing makes room for a checklist on a plain wall. The presenter quiets at the edge (slightly desaturated and dimmed) while the lines appear in the newly available space.

items.title: CreatorMotion · Wording Choice
items.summary: Two sentences type into full-width comparison strips with a separate versus beat. The selected sentence keeps the accent treatment while the other recedes into a quieter reading state.
